text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Gain in node-only curtailment cost at the 0.5 scaled limit, 12 to 36 hour leads, % of the no-knowledge cost, against observed power (higher is better). Relative comparison between forecasts at Primary substations; no money is saved. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole simulated shifts (and whole calendar months for ordinary rows). Zero: same as no knowledge.'
text.tspan: Gain in node-only curtailment cost at the 0.5 scaled limit, 12 to 36 hour leads, % of
